description:
The easiest way to cook and bake with ChatGPT!

Just ask it to suggest a recipe, and this app displays it in an easy to use widget.

e.g.

- "@1-2-3-Cook+Bake Food to eat! Display the recipe for apple pie in a widget"
- "@1-2-3-Cook+Bake Food to eat!  show me Duck a l'Orange"
- "How can I make spaghetti bolognese @1-2-3-Cook+Bake Food to eat!"
